title: Aftercode Portfolio Intelligence CMS
shortDescription: Autonomous multi-repo AST analyzer, Remotion video reel engine, and developer portfolio CMS with zero-cost media generation.
description: Aftercode Portfolio CMS automates codebase analysis across local and remote GitHub repositories. It parses AST import graphs, extracts REST API endpoints, determines technology stack tokens, generates 4K OpenGraph thumbnails with Playwright, and renders programmatic MP4 video reels with Remotion.

title: Portfolio Admin
shortDescription: Portfolio Admin Panel - Backend Server Complete MVC backend server with MongoDB and Express. Features - Authentication: JWT-based authentication system - CRUD Operations: Comple...
description:
portfolio-admin is a production-grade software engineering system implemented primarily in JavaScript, TypeScript. and structured persistence powered by MongoDB.

System Architecture & Component Topology: The core application is partitioned into clear service boundaries. Backend request processing is powered by Express, WebSockets, managing incoming payload validation, CORS policies, and rate-limiting middleware. The user presentation layer is built using React, TailwindCSS, utilizing reactive component hierarchies and state management. The codebase is structured modularly across key functional boundaries including Server (server), Controllers (server/controllers), Models (server/models), Routes (server/routes), Services (src/services), Utils (src/utils), Src (src), Components (src/pages/studio/tools/pdf/components), Lib (src/lib), Pages (src/pages).

Data Pipeline & Execution Lifecycle: Incoming requests follow a deterministic lifecycle. The network interface exposes 94 primary REST/WebSocket routes including GET /, GET /:id, POST /, PUT /:id. Requests enter through designated entrypoint routes, pass through authentication and parameter validation, and execute business logic within isolated service modules. Output data frames and JSON models are serialized cleanly back to callers.

Infrastructure, Reliability & Build System: Environment variables are managed using isolated configuration templates. Automated linting, static analysis, and code quality checks are enforced via TypeScript, ESLint.

Project Background & Documentation: Portfolio Admin Panel - Backend Server Complete MVC backend server with MongoDB and Express. ## Features - **Authentication**: JWT-based authentication system - **CRUD Operations**: Complete CRUD for all entities - **Image Workflow**: Store public image URLs directly in MongoDB - **RESTful API**: Clean and organized REST API endpoints - **Security**: Protected routes with JWT middleware - **MVC Architecture**: Models, Controllers, and Routes separation │ ├── db.js # Mon
